top_signals.title: Trump Says US Still Sharing Intelligence With Ukraine
top_signals.summary: Kelly Grieco, a senior fellow at global research firm the Stimson Center, said a ceasefire on attacking energy infrastructure between Russia and Ukraine benefits the Russians more as the country is able to sell oil to fund the war. Grieco said that even if Ukraine is not able to hit Russian energy infrastructure there are still ways to inflict damage including hitting at travel hubs like airports.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Guyana Oil Exports Set to Surpass 1 Million Barrels per Day for First Time
top_signals.summary: Guyana, one of the world's newest oil exporters, is poised to surpass one million barrels per day in crude oil exports for the first time this December, marking another extraordinary milestone for the small South American country. According to Bloomberg, December's preliminary loading schedule includes 33 million barrels of crude exports, equivalent to approximately 1.06 million bpd.
